D5/S3/Combinatorics/PerfectMatchings/Alt.signature: theorem alternating_cycle_flip {M : G.Subgraph} (hM : M.IsPerfectMatching) {v : V} {p : G.Walk v v} (hp : p.IsCycle) (ha : p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe.IsAlternating M.spanningCoe) : Even p.length ∧ (∃ N : G.Subgraph, N.IsPerfectMatching ∧ (∀ x y, N.Adj x y ↔ (M.Adj x y ∧ ¬ p.toSubgraph.Adj x y) ∨ (p.toSubgraph.Adj x y ∧ ¬ M.Adj x y))) ∧ ∃ N : (G.induce p.toSubgraph.vertsᶜ).Subgraph, N.IsPerfectMatching

D5/S3/Combinatorics/PerfectMatchings/Alt.signature: theorem alternating_cycle_transport {n : ℕ} (label : V ≃ Fin (2 * n)) {epsilon : G.Dart → ZMod 2} (he : Reverses epsilon) (M : {M : G.Subgraph // M.IsPerfectMatching}) {v : V} {p : G.Walk v v} (hp : p.IsCycle) (ha : p.toSubgraph.spanningCoe.IsAlternating M.val.spanningCoe) : ∃ N : {N : G.Subgraph // N.IsPerfectMatching}, (∀ x y, N.val.Adj x y ↔ (M.val.Adj x y ∧ ¬p.toSubgraph.Adj x y) ∨ (p.toSubgraph.Adj x y ∧ ¬M.val.Adj x y)) ∧ matchingTau label epsilon M * matchingTau label epsilon N = -(p.darts.map (dartSign epsilon)).prod
